assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to optimize rate control and assess for further arrhythmic burden.
The condition is coded as I48.0.
The condition is coded as I48.91.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is coded as CPT 93247.
The denial indicates that long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Coverage determinations are based strictly on the terms of the active policy.
The service falls outside the defined parameters of coverage.
The patient has the right to appeal the denial decision.
An appeal requires a written request detailing clinical necessity and supporting documentation within the specified timeframe.
Failure to submit timely appeals may result in forfeiture of appeal rights.
